verdict.rationale: Severing and purging connections is a fair axis for an open banking data platform, but the evidence pack never documents deleting a consent, connection or user, stopping collection, or purging held data. The only consent-lifecycle item is re-authorisation, which extends access rather than ending it, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can sever and clean up — a documented way to delete a connection or user and have the platform stop collecting and purge held data
